Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Mobile Development Productivity team makes building, testing, and releasing Stripe’s mobile applications and device-integrated software fast, reliable, and secure. The team owns the mobile development platform end to end, including development environments, simulators and emulators, continuous integration, automated testing, builds, and releases. We support engineers working across iOS, Android, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, mobile SDKs, and device-integrated software.

Our customers include engineers working on Stripe Dashboard Mobile, Link, Stripe’s mobile SDKs, and Terminal. We enable mobile engineers to use AI agents throughout the development process, including writing code, running tests, and validating changes across mobile platforms. Our work reduces manual release effort, improves test coverage, and makes mobile development faster and more reliable.

What you’ll do

You will improve the platform that Stripe engineers use to build mobile applications and device-integrated software. You will draw on your experience building mobile applications to understand where development is slow or unreliable, then build tools and systems that improve the experience across teams and platforms.

You will also help make AI agents effective participants in mobile development. This includes giving agents access to realistic development environments, simulators and emulators, test frameworks, and the feedback they need to validate changes. You will work closely with mobile product teams and infrastructure teams, and you will operate the systems you build.

Responsibilities

  • Build mobile development environments and workflows that enable engineers and AI agents to develop, test, and validate changes remotely
  • Improve the speed, reliability, and usability of development workflows and continuous integration across iOS, Android, React Native, and other device-integrated platforms
  • Develop automated testing infrastructure for unit, integration, end-to-end, network snapshot, and visual regression testing
  • Automate secure build and release processes for mobile applications, SDKs, and device software, reducing reliance on developer laptops and manual operations
  • Integrate code-authoring, review, and validation tools into mobile development workflows and repositories
  • Partner with mobile product and infrastructure teams to identify recurring development bottlenecks and build reusable solutions
  • Operate the systems the team owns, participate in on-call support, and improve their reliability using measures of developer productivity, build and test performance, and release health

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, not including internships or co-ops
  • Experience building and maintaining mobile applications for iOS, Android, or a cross-platform mobile framework
  • Experience writing reliable, maintainable code and tests in a collaborative software engineering environment
  • Ability to diagnose problems across application code, development tools, and build or test systems
  • Ability to work with engineers across teams to understand their needs and deliver practical improvements
  • Interest in learning unfamiliar parts of the mobile development lifecycle, including development environments, continuous integration, testing, builds, releases, and production operations
  • Experience leading large, complex projects with multiple engineers across teams and organizations, explaining technical tradeoffs, building alignment with partners and leaders, and mentoring engineers in an environment where technologies and priorities change quickly
  • Experience mentoring engineers, and helping the team use AI to build and understand systems faster while keeping quality and reliability hig

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building developer infrastructure, developer tools, continuous integration systems, or automated testing frameworks
  • Experience with Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, or mobile SDK development

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

This role focuses on strengthening OKX US' first line of defense while serving as the primary operational engine and bridge between the US business and control functions. Operating in a highly fluid environment, this position bridges the gap between hands-on internal controls and strategic US market execution.

You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with control functions across every aspect of the US business, from managing KYC/KYB onboarding pipelines and marketing content reviews to leading US executive reporting and customer support alignment. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, moves comfortably between granular risk management and growth strategy, and elevates organizational maturity to sustain OKX’s growth, integrity, and regulatory excellence.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Controls Partnership & Operational Strategy

  • KYC / KYB Pipeline & Remediation: Support Compliance-managed KYC and KYB onboarding pipelines, identifying friction points, accelerating throughput between business units and Compliance, and resolving operational friction.
  • Risk Governance and Coordination: Serve as the key liaison to the US Risk organization, providing assistance in the monitoring of KRIs and the implementation of the risk framework.
  • Customer-Facing Content Governance: Lead the cross-functional workflow for Compliance and Legal reviews of growth assets, including marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional materials, and client communications.
  • Client Support & Compliance Alignment: Partner closely with Client Support and Compliance to streamline escalated customer workflows, ensure client support operations reflect regulatory requirements, and resolve customer-impacting compliance bottlenecks.
  • Controls Product Management: Work with Legal, Compliance, and Risk to understand key risks associated with new product launches, and utilize relationships with Product to promote innovation and product delivery.
 

Local Market Governance

  • Executive Reporting: Lead and coordinate reporting for executive meeting cadences, including soliciting updates and insight from business and control leads to present a cohesive view of US market performance and opportunities.
  • Policy & Procedures: Support the drafting and upkeep of operational policies and procedures. Prepare regular risk, control, and operational performance reporting for senior leadership.
  • First-Line Defense Leadership: Represent business operations in first-line risk management activities, supporting RCSAs, maintaining risk registers, and ensuring control effectiveness.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Experience: 3+ years of progressive experience in Strategic Operations, Program Management, Compliance Operations, Governance, or Risk Management within fintech, crypto/web3, or heavily regulated financial services.
  • Fluidity & Growth Mindset: A "builder" mindset with high comfort in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments. Ability to pivot smoothly from tactical execution (tracking pipeline bottlenecks) to strategic alignment (launching new market initiatives).
  • Incident & Process Acumen: Proven track record leading cross-departmental incident response, mapping workflows, and executing post-incident remediation.
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Superior written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across control and first line teams.

  • L&D programs for employees' growth and development

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

This role sits within User Policy Operations. User Policy Operations assesses the risk that users pose to Stripe against our Terms of Service and related policies. Its work helps ensure that the businesses we support are aligned with those policies, and it protects Stripe, our partners, and the broader user community. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide every Stripe user with the best support experience possible.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will be a player-coach leading a team of Risk Operations associates who assess complex and unique user situations against Stripe's Terms of Service and related policies. Their assessments determine whether Stripe can continue to support these users. Many of them are among Stripe's most strategic, so the work calls for urgency, sound judgment, and a clear view of the risk each user poses to Stripe.

Your team will often work beyond the written workflow and policy. They will dig into the facts of each case, assess the risk to Stripe, and turn that into clear, well-reasoned recommendations. As their leader, you will help them move quickly through ambiguity, get up to speed fast on the situations they're handling, and work through friction when engaging across the risk ecosystem, including cross-functional partners and account teams. Through clear goals, guidance, and mentorship, you will set both individuals and the team up for success.

To be a fit, you will have a coaching mindset, proven ability to communicate at different levels, a track record of driving operational performance, and a passion for inspiring a team to deliver outstanding results.In this role, you will act in a player-coach capacity and are accountable for supporting Risk/Partner Risk Operations associates.  

Responsibilities

  • Lead and coach a team of associates conducting Terms of Service evaluations and risk assessments on complex and strategic users, determining whether those users remain aligned with Stripe's policies and whether Stripe can continue to support them
  • Coach your team to think beyond what is written in policy: to investigate thoroughly, weigh the broader risk a user presents to Stripe, and make sound, well-documented recommendations in ambiguous or unprecedented situations
  • Manage your team through complex risk situations, including those that require cross-functional engagement and close collaboration with account teams and other partners across the risk ecosystem
  • Quickly understand the cases your team is working on, and help remove blockers and navigate friction points when working across teams
  • Foster a sense of urgency on strategic user cases, balancing speed with quality, rigor, and consistency of decisions
  • Support and coach your team in conducting thorough investigations of merchant accounts to facilitate progressive and sustainable business growth
  • Ongoing management of the operational performance of your team to deliver KPIs and report to key stakeholders
  • Help scale our operations and improve user experience by identifying process and policy improvements, including gaps surfaced through complex case work
  • Manage capacity and scheduling, dividing and assigning work between team members, including routing complex and time-sensitive cases appropriately
  • Ensure your team has all the skills and resources needed to be successful in their role
  • Set clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement to refine team processes and procedures
  • Support recruitment and hiring initiatives
  • Contribute to 20% core work on a daily basis
  • Coach and mentor individuals to meet career goals via structured development conversations
  • Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate periodic formal performance reviews
  • Drive and own initiatives that make the team a warm and welcoming place to work
  • Keep the team engaged and motivated towards their work

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A minimum of 6+ years of experience in risk operations or policy/supportability operations
  • Experience coaching/leading operations teams and managing performance
  • Experience mentoring others and are able to constructively provide feedback to others
  • Experience in delivering weekly and monthly business metrics and reporting
  • Proven ability to be a subject matter expert in Risk Operations

  • Ability to work cross functionally, including with account teams and stakeholders supporting strategic users, to deliver best results and promote partnership
  • Ability to work with urgency and manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish
  • Exemplary planning and time management skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge of risk reviews, knowledge in policy/compliance operations, and fraud detection tools
  • Experience managing risk events in the system, and identify the at-risk scenario.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

Master your verticals and sell with precision

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)

About the position

We're opening our first internships in the Formal Methods group of our OCaml Language team, which develops language features and tooling for correctness reasoning and bug finding in OCaml programs. With the emergence of agentic programming, we think formal methods will play a major role in helping validate agent-generated code and providing feedback for agents. Our vision is to make formal methods as useful a tool for building software as type systems are for us today, both by leveraging existing tools and technology, and pursuing novel approaches. 

During the internship, we want to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll be paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on a real-world project that combines your research background with one of our active projects, such as adding support for property-based testing of formal specifications or developing a refinement type system for functional correctness verification. You’ll have the opportunity to evaluate the tools you develop on a large, actively developed production codebase. You'll also be able to attend guest speakers and social events, and hopefully get a real sense of what it would be like to work here full-time.

There is plenty of work on combining agents and formal methods. What’s different at Jane Street is that we aren't stuck designing verification tools for legacy languages: we can modify and improve OxCaml, our branch of OCaml, and its development environment to make them well-suited for proof-driven software development. Moreover, we have a community of excellent programmers who are eager to adopt these tools and apply them to real software.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is seeking a Fraud Operations Manager to help build and lead a team of Fraud Operations Specialists responsible for the efficient and effective execution of fraud detection and prevention strategies across all of Ramp’s products, enabling Ramp’s rapid growth. This role requires the ability to balance people management, process engineering, strategic thinking, and planning. You will utilize data and analytics to lead an efficient team, identify opportunities for improvement, prioritize development, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to operationalize policies, develop tools, and infrastructure that best support Ramp’s operations.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and continue building a team of Fraud Operations Specialists who manage & review alerts, conduct investigations, and recover funds through enabling right sized coverage and meeting service level agreements (SLA)

  • Develop a deep understanding of Ramp’s risk management policies (underwriting, payments, transactions, credit limit changes, collections) across all products

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams to build best in class risk tooling to increase operational efficiency

  • Partner with risk strategy teams to create a closed loop process to enhance policies and procedures

  • Leverage data and analytics to evaluate and prioritize solutions to improve operational efficiency

  • Research emerging fraud trends to innovate on Ramp's decisioning systems and policies

  • Help coordinate and respond to incidents through on-call duties as needed – in addition to customer escalations or sensitive case handling

  • Partner with Customer Support to educate and create awareness on fraud prevention best practices, identifying social engineering attempts, and support customers

What You Need

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in risk management including account takeovers and a broad range of payment related fraud

  • Minimum 2 years of experience building and managing teams

  • Strong background in process development and improvement

  • Investigative and critical thinking skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience integrating AI into your daily work

  • Experience within consumer/corporate/small business cards, payments, invoices, lending, or related industries

GoMining is a Bitcoin cloud-mining platform that has grown into a full crypto ecosystem: Digital Miners, the GOMINING token, GoMining Card, Wallet, Simple Earn, the VIP programme and Miner Wars. We’re growing fast and plan to multiply sales next year. A large part of that growth will come from partners who already have big audiences.

This role brings those partners in across Asia. We’re hiring one BDM per region, and this position covers the Asian market. You’ll find and sign affiliates and partners with large networks in Asia: crypto exchanges and media, iGaming operators and affiliate networks, brokers, fintech players, streamers and influencer agencies. Our offer to them is one of the strongest on the market: a high commission on every sale their audience makes, plus a lifetime revenue share. Your job is to put that offer in front of the right people and close the deal.

This is not a desk job and not mass cold outreach. You’ll spend much of your time in the field, at conferences, expos and meetings across Asia, holding live negotiations every day. You’ll be one of the first members of a regional BD team we’re building from scratch. Your income grows directly with the volume your partners bring in, and the bonus is uncapped.

What you’ll do

Hunting: find the partners who matter

  • Map the partners with the biggest reach in Asia: crypto (exchanges, wallets, media, communities), iGaming and gambling (operators, affiliate networks, streamers), brokers (forex, CFD, investment platforms), fintech and payments, large media and influencer agencies.
  • Work the field: attend crypto, iGaming, affiliate and fintech conferences across Asia, book meetings in advance and close partnerships on site.
  • Use your own network and local reputation to get in front of decision-makers, not just whoever answers an email.

Closing: run the full cycle

  • Own every deal end to end: first contact, negotiation, agreeing terms, onboarding, launching traffic and the first sales.
  • Negotiate with founders and senior management, and show clearly what partnering with GoMining is worth to them and their audience.
  • When a partner says no, find out why and bring that back so we can sharpen the offer.

Growing: turn partners into volume

  • Grow the partners you’ve signed: higher volume, new formats, and special offers for their audiences.
  • Keep your pipeline up to date in the CRM, report weekly on the funnel, and file a short results report after every trip.
  • Share what you see in the Asian market (competitor offers, partner expectations, local payment specifics) with the team.

What success looks like

  • First month: you know the product and the partner offer inside out, your Asia pipeline is mapped, and your conference and meeting calendar for the next quarter is set.
  • First 3 months: you’re running a steady rhythm of in-person meetings, your first partnerships are signed and live, and the first sales are coming in through your partners.
  • Ongoing: we measure you on new active partners per month, sales volume and revenue from those partners, and how well your meetings convert into signed deals.
  • 3+ years in business development, partnerships or affiliate management in crypto, iGaming, gambling, brokerage or fintech.
  • Your own network in Asia (affiliates, networks, operators, media). This is the main requirement.
  • A track record of closing large partnership deals, with numbers you can walk us through.
  • Confidence negotiating with founders and senior management.
  • Readiness to travel a lot to conferences and meetings across Asia.
  • A hunter mindset: proactive, fast-paced, driven by results and money.
  • Fluent English.

Would be a plus

  • An Asian language: Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian or another language of the region.
  • A personal reputation in the local crypto, affiliate or iGaming community.
  • A strong grasp of affiliate models (CPA, RevShare, hybrid) and traffic.
  • Experience with large affiliate networks and streamers.
  • Knowledge of payment specifics in Asian markets.
  • Sales-driven pay: a fixed salary plus an uncapped bonus on the sales volume your partners bring in.
  • A travel and conference budget for field work across Asia.
  • Fast decisions and direct access to the head of the direction.
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days + 8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead.

You’ll work with a named account list, identify where Stripe can solve complex business challenges, and turn those opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll focus on acquiring new enterprise customers across Australia. This is a hunting role: you’ll build pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, develop relationships across complex organisations, and lead opportunities from initial engagement through commercial negotiation, signing, and launch.

You’ll create and execute account strategies that connect prospective customers’ business priorities with Stripe’s platform. Working with executive and technical stakeholders, you’ll develop business cases, shape multi-product solutions, and demonstrate Stripe’s value in competitive sales processes.

We’re looking for a commercially ambitious and highly autonomous seller who can balance near-term revenue delivery with the relationship building required to win strategic enterprise accounts.   • Own a named portfolio of prospective enterprise accounts across ANZ and develop strategic account plans to win new business.
  • Build and execute targeted outbound strategies to create qualified opportunities and maintain a strong pipeline.
  • Map complex organisations, identify decision-makers, and build relationships with executive sponsors and stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, and Payments.

  • Understand prospective customers’ business and technical challenges, and position Stripe’s platform and products against their priorities.
  • Lead product workshops, business case development, and financial analyses that help prospective customers quantify the value of adopting Stripe.
  • Develop competitive deal strategies and lead complex negotiations involving multiple stakeholders and bespoke commercial agreements.
  • Partner with internal technical, product, partnerships, and post-sales teams to shape solutions and support a coordinated transition from signing to implementation and launch.

not a requirement.

  • Proven ability to develop and execute account plans across complex organisations with multiple business units, stakeholders, or subsidiaries.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through solution development, commercial negotiation, and close.
  • Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value and engage confidently with senior business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills, including experience building business cases and securing executive support.
  • Ability to prioritise independently and make progress in a fast-moving environment with ambiguity.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling to enterprise organisations in Australia and New Zealand.
  • Experience selling payments, financial infrastructure, or technically complex software platforms.
  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company.
  • Experience working closely with technical pre-sales, product, partnerships, and implementation teams.

GOLDMAN SACHS ALTERNATIVES

Goldman Sachs Asset Management is one of the world’s leading asset managers with over $3 trillion in assets under supervision. As the primary investment area within Goldman Sachs, we provide investment and advisory services for pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors, and individuals.

GSAM invests both the firm's own capital and capital raised from outside investors in corporate equity and debt, real estate equity and debt, asset-based equity and debt, growth equity and infrastructure assets world-wide. Our business operates on a global platform, and we are one of the largest managers of private capital globally.

GSAM Private Credit is one of the world’s largest alternative credit investing platforms with approximately $110bn of AUM and investment professionals based in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia. GSAM Private Credit is a dynamic platform with significant cross-pollination across strategies – Direct Lending (middle market and large cap performing credit), Hybrid Capital, Asset Finance, Structured Corporate Credit and IG Corporate and Infrastructure Credit.

STRUCTURED CORPORATE CREDIT

Structured Corporate Credit (“SCC”) is a growth area within Private Credit, focusing on financings backed by various forms of corporate credit support. SCC provides flexible funding solutions across the capital structure, engaging in a broad range of structured solutions as well as a wide range of asset classes, products, industries and sectors, including digital infrastructure, power, utilities and healthcare.

This is an opportunity to play an important role in the development and growth of our global structured corporate credit platform and to get exposure to a global team and its full spectrum of activities, which are varied and challenging. These encompass transaction origination, underwriting, structuring, risk management and execution. Combined with the small deal team sizes, the broad range of transaction structures and sectors in which we invest provide an extremely wide range of exposure and skill set development. 

Client focus and creativity are the cornerstones of our business. We strive towards an entrepreneurial, flexible, and open culture, where we work collaboratively with teams across GSAM, as well as the broader Goldman Sachs franchise, on initiatives that further improve overall performance and enable us to anticipate our clients’ evolving needs. At Goldman Sachs, our culture is one of teamwork, innovation and meritocracy. We often say our people are our greatest asset and we take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. 

Managing Directors support the business by working as part of small deal teams responsible for identifying, conducting due diligence, structuring, executing, and monitoring investments.  The broad range of transaction structures and sectors in which we invest give Managing Directors a broad range of exposure and ample opportunities to develop their investment acumen. They are also responsible for the training and support of the junior team members, ensuring effective portfolio management, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Given the growing nature of the investment strategy, Managing Directors in Structured Corporate Credit form part of the core team from the start which results in a highly entrepreneurial and flat working environment and exciting career development opportunities. 

Responsibilities

  • Originating investment opportunities across the product suite of Structured Corporate Credit Credit via early engagement with relevant parties (e.g. borrowers, sponsors and advisors)
  • Leading all aspects of due diligence, business analysis and structuring to develop and refine investment theses
  • Driving key work streams in structuring, negotiating and documenting investments
  • Communicating and defending investment theses to internal stakeholders and committees, including relevant Investment Committees
  • Actively monitoring existing investments in the portfolio
  • Involvement in internal fund management and investor communications
  • Contributing to platform expansion and potentially the introduction of new investment strategies 

 

Qualifications

  • Strong quantitative, financial modelling, analytical and problem-solving skills with a clear view to form independent judgements
  • Passion for investing with specific interest in credit and structured products

  • Flexible and creative mindset; ability to analyze a variety of industries and businesses and capital structures
